candidates.explanation: After the password is changed, the user's existing sessions are never deleted. Refresh tokens are validated against the session, so a device that was already signed in can keep refreshing its login. The service already has deleteByUserId, but resetPassword never calls it.

fix.description: After usersService.update in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) so every session is revoked and refresh fails.
